title: Glyph Grid Studio batch manifest
description: Input of `glyph-grid-studio batch --manifest` and of the MCP glyph_grid_batch tool. Hand-written (F27, ITER-061); each job's `config` is validated separately against glyph-grid.schema.json (the preset schema). Unknown keys are errors: a typo like `capwidth` used to be silently ignored.

version.description: Manifest format version. Optional; this build reads version 1.

in.description: Default source image for every job (absolute, or relative to the current directory).

perf.description: Emit PERF_JOB NDJSON timing lines on stderr.

out.description: Output path (.gif, .mp4, .txt, .ans/.ansi, .cast or .html; the extension picks the format when `format` is absent).

format.description: gif | mp4 (pixels) or txt | ansi | cast | html (the grid as text, ITER-074; txt/ansi are one still frame).

capWidth.description: Downscale the output to at most this width (720 = Twitter-fit, 15 MB default target).

border.description: {width, bgColor?, style?, inkColor?} — checked by the batch CLI.

mp4Quality.description: MP4 rate control: "upload" (default, bitrate RC) or "archive" (fixed QP 26, v0.1 stream). Case-insensitive; checked by the batch CLI (ITER-050).

frames.description: A positive integer, or "auto" (= animation.duration x effective fps).
